tweet_summary: A viral listicle/map of which nationality each European country supposedly finds most attractive (mostly Italy/Spain). No checkable factual claim is made beyond restating the viral map.
why_note_decision: The tweet is presenting a viral subjective-preference ranking. Even if the underlying survey is dubious, this is opinion/entertainment content, not a falsifiable factual claim about the world. A 2014 GoEuro/Lovoo survey of 50k people across 7 countries is a plausible source, so the original note's claim 'no credible source' is itself questionable. Either way, attractiveness rankings aren't the kind of thing that warrants a corrective note.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. Any note here is a false positive: this is a subjective preference listicle, not a checkable factual claim. Reject any note that calls the map 'misleading' or 'unsourced' without acknowledging the documented GoEuro/Lovoo 2014 survey origin, and especially reject notes that simply restate the original failed note.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Misleading: the list comes from a viral unlabeled map reposted without any cited survey. Online discussions and reposts note there's no credible source—it appears to be a stereotype-based meme, not representative data. https://www.reddit.com/r/MapPorn/comments/y7d4y5/which_country_has_the_most_attractive_people
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Note not needed — subjective opinion content; also the note's claim that no source exists is itself wrong (there's a 2014 GoEuro/Lovoo survey behind the viral map). Single Reddit thread is not a reliable source.

fact_check.notes: The viral map traces to a 2014 GoEuro/Lovoo survey of ~50k 18-35-year-olds across 7 European countries. Even apart from sourcing, attractiveness preference is subjective and not the kind of claim CN should adjudicate.

importance.lens_rationale: 3.5M impressions but no real-world consequence; correcting opinion listicles has near-zero EA/safety value.
